# One-Line Power

> Power training for data center electrical teams: power systems fundamentals, power distribution, emergency and standby power, UPS operations and electrical safety.

One-Line Power (https://dc-power.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Power Systems & Electrical, Power Distribution Systems, Emergency/Standby Power Systems, UPS Operations & Load Testing or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://dc-power.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [Power Systems & Electrical Fundamentals](https://dc-power.hazwoperosha.us/courses/power-systems-electrical-fundamentals): $303.99 per seat, 8 Hours, NFPA 70E. Master data center electrical infrastructure — from utility interconnection to UPS and PDU architecture. Enroll: https://dc-power.hazwoperosha.us/courses/power-systems-electrical-fundamentals?buy=847
- [Power Distribution Systems Fundamentals](https://dc-power.hazwoperosha.us/courses/power-distribution-systems-fundamentals): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours. Core power distribution theory behind PDUs, panels, and branch circuits. Enroll: https://dc-power.hazwoperosha.us/courses/power-distribution-systems-fundamentals?buy=1092
- [Emergency/Standby Power Systems Fundamentals](https://dc-power.hazwoperosha.us/courses/emergency-standby-power-systems-fundamentals): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours. Understand the standby power systems that carry a facility through a utility outage. Enroll: https://dc-power.hazwoperosha.us/courses/emergency-standby-power-systems-fundamentals?buy=1098
- [UPS Operations & Load Testing](https://dc-power.hazwoperosha.us/courses/ups-operations-load-testing): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours. Master UPS operations, battery testing, and load-bank procedures. Enroll: https://dc-power.hazwoperosha.us/courses/ups-operations-load-testing?buy=840
- [UPS Systems Fundamentals](https://dc-power.hazwoperosha.us/courses/ups-systems-fundamentals): $99.99 per seat, 2 Hours. Foundational UPS theory to complement hands-on operations and load testing. Enroll: https://dc-power.hazwoperosha.us/courses/ups-systems-fundamentals?buy=1102
- [Electrical Safety & Best Practices](https://dc-power.hazwoperosha.us/courses/electrical-safety-best-practices): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours, NFPA 70E. NFPA 70E-aligned electrical safety fundamentals for facility staff. Enroll: https://dc-power.hazwoperosha.us/courses/electrical-safety-best-practices?buy=831

## Guides

- [How to read a data center one-line diagram](https://dc-power.hazwoperosha.us/guides/reading-a-one-line-diagram): The symbols and the path, from the utility to the rack.
- [What happens in the first 30 seconds of a utility failure](https://dc-power.hazwoperosha.us/guides/what-happens-when-the-utility-fails): UPS, generators and transfer switches, second by second.
